ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional: Claude Code via API key (otherwise run `claude` and log in once)

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Required for the Aider Gemini fallback (and optional for the Gemini CLI). Set the key only in this Codespaces secret.

OPENAI_API_BASE.description: Required for Aider: OpenAI-compatible gateway URL. It must end with /p1/v1. Set the current host only in this Codespaces secret.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Required for Aider: bearer token for the OpenAI-compatible gateway.

CAMBER_API_KEY.description: Optional: Camber CLI auth. Set only if INSTALL_CAMBER=1. Value comes from the Camber profile page.

MDB_MCP_CONNECTION_STRING.description: Required for the MongoDB MCP server. Connection string only; do not commit it.

INSTALL_CAMBER.description: Optional: set to 1 to run .devcontainer/camber-install.sh during post-create.
